items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I sent and got ... my wife, Freddi Bowen ... We used to go to church together and I sent for her and we got married here in New York.

ctx.x: Where were you living at this time when you were living in New York?

I was living -- I think I was living -- I was living at 137th Street. Rented a whole first floor from the people that had a private home. Then I stayed there until I sent and got (inaudible) my wife, Freddi Bowen (inaudible), her name is Freddi (inaudible). She was a church member. We used to go to church together and I sent for her and we got married here in New York. After I came out of that dancing school, Chick was fooling around getting his band together, you know. But I didn't come out of the dancing school…
